name: EOSeven
rootCause: EOSeven was transferred 600 million SVN from eosevendice2 to account tuningfinish, then back 450 million to eosevendice2. After that, tuningfinish sold the SVN token on Newdex and finally transferred the resulting EOS to Binance Exchange.
